claim: Produces a maintain cycle record: framed harm with severity/audience/health signal, root cause on the owning layer, fix with regression lock, oracle rerun, and residual risk.

baseline.prompt: Write maintain.md describing how you would fix a production bug where checkout fails with a 500 for some users. Include diagnosis, fix, and how you would verify.

tasks.description: Fresh-context agent with the full procedure produces the maintain cycle elements.
tasks.prompt: Read ./SKILL.md completely, then write maintain.md for one maintain cycle: checkout returns 500 for ~5% of users after the last release. Follow the method: frame (symptom, severity, audience, health signal that must improve), research (reproduce, bisect, owning layer), admit in/out, implement root-cause fix with a regression lock, deliver/verify by re-running the failing oracle, and record residual risk. Output: harm, cause, fix, oracle, residual risk.
